status: draft: control_count and the reference budget are set from the dev pilot before any held-out run
quality_target: each player's best-response gain <= min(1% of the root pot, 0.1 BB), in the declared capped, projected search game
control_rule: the first control_count / 2 roots of each held-out panel, in panel order
gate_reading: quality and belief gates apply to every evaluated held-out decision or control; coverage needs at least 90% of eligible held-out decisions; latency needs median <= 0.5 s and p95 <= 2 s
